desc:
Live inside a cozy mouse hole.  
Explore hidden tunnels, fight cockroaches, and survive in a human-sized world.  

👥 Play with friends
Temporarily unlock Gubby when you’re in the same server as a friend.

📅Daily Login Explained
You get 1 daily login if you log into the game anytime during a full day based on New York time (EST).
That means:

• You don’t need to log in at a specific hour.
• As long as you open the game at least once between 12:00 AM and 11:59 PM EST, it counts!
• Even if you’re in a different time zone, the game still uses New York time to track logins.

💰 Coins System
Whenever a monster dies, everyone gets Coins — no matter who did the killing!

I want you to get creative with how you defeat monsters — just like Tom & Jerry!

👍100 like = New boss
